text:
infra-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Increased p99 latency observed on /svc/streaming endpoints starting ~2535006700. p95 ~420ms, p99 ~2.3s. Streaming stalls and tail spikes. Auto-mitigation attempted (reroute -> fallback) but persisted.
Alex (oncall): Investigating. Noticed burst at 2535006680-2535006740, spike correlates with a config rollout `prefix-salting-v2`. Can someone confirm rollout? :eyes:
Priya (SRE): I see the same on grafana: query `sum(rate(stream.latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)` shows p99 jump at 2535006685. Also streaming stall count up ~120.
Carlos (platform): That rollout was the prefix/key-salting change pushed by release pipeline at 2535006678 via `deploy-bot`. It changed the prefix mapping for cache keys to add salt for key-entropy.
Alex (oncall): That would explain cache hit drop. Can we check cache hitrate?
Logbot: Cache metrics snapshot: cache_hit_rate: 0.12 (baseline 0.82), key_misses/s: +18k, eviction_rate: +4x.
Priya (SRE): Low hit rate + increased backend calls -> tail latency. Streaming path depends on prefix cache for KV lookups, so stalls if miss-induced backend paging occurs.
Morgan (PM): Do we have customer impact? Any errors surfaced to clients?
Sally (CSM): CSMs reporting 2 customers (alpha-enterprise, beta-app) called in about slow responses on chat streaming. No dropped responses, just high latency and occasional stalls. They're on Dedicated clusters in region-us-west.
Alex (oncall): Immediate plan: 1) rollback prefix-salting-v2, 2) open short-term routing to older model variant for affected customers, 3) kick cache-warmup job once rollback completes. Priya, can you coordinate rollback?
Priya (SRE): On it. Running rollback: `deploy rollback service=prefix-mapper release=prefix-salting-v2`
deploy-bot: Rollback job started by Priya at 2535006860. Job id: rb-2535-07.
Priya (SRE): Rollback finished at 2535006945. Verified config now at `prefix-salting-v1` in prod.
Alex (oncall): Observing metrics... p99 dropping. New values: p95 ~300ms, p99 ~450ms after 60s. Streaming stall count decreasing.
Carlos (platform): We should avoid full cache flush — that would cause coldstart thrash. Instead I'm triggering a staged rehydrate: `scripts/warmup-prefix.sh --targets=alpha-enterprise,beta-app --rate=50rps` to prepopulate hot prefixes.
Priya (SRE): Warmup started 2535006990. We'll watch hitrate and backend qdepth.
Logbot: After rollback and warmup: cache_hit_rate: 0.78, key_misses/s trending down, backend queue length back to baseline.
Alex (oncall): Good. Next: root cause: prefix-salting-v2 changed the hashing salt which means existing cache entries are never matched -> effective cache invalidation across clusters. That produced a huge miss-wave and caused backend paging to spike, increasing tail latencies.
Morgan (PM): Action items: - Postmortem with timeline and why canary didn't catch this - Add automated hitrate checks to rollout gating - Consider gradual salt-rollout with paired key acceptance mode. Assign owners?
Priya (SRE): I'll own immediate RCA and postmortem draft. Carlos, can you add rollout gating?
Carlos (platform): Yep. Proposal: for future prefix changes, enable dual-hash compatibility flag for 24h then flip, plus a rate-limited traffic ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%). I'll open a PR and link.
Sally (CSM): I'll reach out to the two impacted customers with an incident summary and ETA for postmortem.
Alex (oncall): Handoff: Priya taking lead for the rest of the night for postmortem and follow-ups. I'll leave a runbook note.
Priya (SRE): Opening incident ticket: INC-2535006789. Notes: severity=P2 (SLO breach p99>2s), cause=cache-key-salting rollout, mitigation=rollback+staged-warmup, impact=increased latency for streaming endpoints, affected customers listed.
deploy-bot: Incident ticket INC-2535006789 created and assigned to Priya.
Alex (oncall): Any lingering user-visible issues?
Sally (CSM): Clients report performance back to normal after ~5-8 minutes post-rollback. No data loss.
Priya (SRE): Follow-ups: 1) Postmortem due EOD tomorrow, 2) Add rollout gating test that simulates cache-hit-rate delta, 3) Automate warmup job to run if hit_rate < 0.5 after config changes, 4) Add alert for streaming stall counts (new metric). Assignments: Priya (RCA + postmortem), Carlos (gating PR), Alex (alert + runbook updates), Sally (customer comms), Morgan (PM oversight).
Morgan (PM): Thanks team. Closing thread for active mitigation. We'll reopen if anything else flares. :white_check_mark:
